chapter_seo_title: Chapter 333: The Mourning Ancestor and the Warning Sage – World of Immortality
chapter_meta_description: In the Dead City, a shrouded titan crushes divine islands with ease. A fortune teller laments forgotten ancestors and foretells Xiao Chen's doom. Xiao Chen then storms the imperial palace to confront Zhao Lin'er.
